Alex / Jordan — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery so we can lock the POC plan in motion. Please confirm or flag changes.

Recap & success criteria (proposed)
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for Acme product search reranking at latencies <= 120ms p95 and <40% cost per query vs current baseline.
- Success criteria:
  - Functional: model outputs meet the golden set MAP@10 >= 0.72 (we'll use your 200-query eval set).
  - Performance: cold-start p95 <= 120ms, steady-state p95 <= 80ms on your sample traffic profile.
  - Cost: per-query token cost reduction of at least 40% vs current cloud endpoint.
- Security/compliance: data retention 30 days, request-level logging available to Acme SOC.

POC plan & timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): access + infra checks (network, SSO certs), agree final eval set and success criteria. Owner: Acme (network/SSO) + Redwood (marcus/priyom).
- Week 1: deploy model to dedicated test pool, run integration tests, begin smoke traffic. Owner: Redwood (marcus).
- Week 2: run full evaluation vs your 200-query golden set, performance/load testing. Owner: Redwood + Acme (data sampling).
- Week 3: results review, decision meeting + next steps.

Owners / asks for this week (please):
- Alex / Jordan: confirm eval set and share sample traffic (s3 link) by Fri 12/4. Confirm when SSO certs and VPN access will be available.
- Acme infra: complete network checklist attached by EOD 12/4.
- Redwood: we will share the POC plan (attached) and a kickoff calendar invite for 12/7.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (detailed plan), network-checklist.xlsx

If that aligns, I'll send calendar invites for the kickoff and loop in our infra/ops.

Thanks —
